summary: Firelookout.ca lists a fire tower on Austin Lake Mountain, Algoma District, at 622 m elevation; the record gives little else.

evidence.supports: Record note: the tower is either on this mountain or one nearby
evidence.quote: The tower here is either on this mountain or one nearby.

evidence.supports: Writer is fairly sure it is on Austin Lake Mountain because it is prominent and visible
evidence.quote: It is visible from the surrounding area and is very prominent, so I'm fairly certain that this is, in fact,

notes_for_editor: Only one source: the Firelookout.ca record. The record's tower type, structure height and year-built fields read N/A, and the note says the tower's location is uncertain (on this mountain or one nearby), so the story does not place the structure precisely. No Austin Lake feature appears in the Ontario LIO fire-tower layer (data/raw/ontario_lio/fire_towers.geojson), and the forestrangers still-standing lists do not name it; a list's silence is not evidence either way, so the story does not use it. The Elliot Lake Fire Tower Lookout (exploreelliotlake.com) is a different tower and is not used. The Firelookout.ca search-result URL austin-lake-mountain-fire-tower/ is an index page with no record, so it is not cited. The story is about 90 words, below the 120-word guide floor, because the evidence is one record; it has not been padded.
